free_tier.stated: The USD 50 is real as an announcement but not as a standing offer. Quoted from the 2026-03-13 post: 'You can now claim $50 in free GPU credits instantly on the Nosana website. No extra steps, no waiting'. Quoted from the November 2025 and October 2025 monthly posts and still live: 'Your credits will be activated and assigned within a few days', and 'you can join the early-access list. No commitment. No payment.' Quoted from the June 2026 post: 'You can verify a payment method to claim free credits or top up your balance'. The live site states only: 'Claim free credits when you log in with email' with no amount.

egress.terms: Also not established: whether credits cover storage or egress separately, since Nosana bills compute from the balance and does not publish a separate storage line.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: The USD 50 does not chain with anything, because the cheap card it was priced against has no host and the cards that do have hosts cost four times as much. If granted, USD 50 is 260 hours on the RTX 3090 that 2 of 39 hosts offer, or 100 hours on a 5090 with 0 of 38 hosts free.

limits.value: Two gates fail before the money does: the grant is not self-serve at a stated amount, since the current route is an early-access list with activation 'within a few days' and the June 2026 route is payment-method verification; then supply fails, because the site reports 0 of 16 hosts on the USD 0.048 RTX 3060 and 2 of 39 on the USD 0.192 RTX 3090.

identity_cost.detail: two routes with different costs. On the current route a payment method must be verified: the June 2026 post states 'You can verify a payment method to claim free credits or top up your balance'. On the early-access route there is no payment at all, quoted 'No commitment. No payment.', with credits activated within a few days. The live site states only 'Claim free credits when you log in with email'. No authorisation amount is stated, and whether debit or prepaid is accepted is not stated
